This is distribution of pornographic material for profit. In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "制作、复制、出版、贩卖、传播淫秽物品罪" (producing, copying, publishing, selling, distributing pornographic materials). So we can output "制作、复制、出版、贩卖、传播淫秽物品". Or maybe just "传播淫秽物品". The fact includes copying and selling. So include both copying and selling. Use "制作、复制、出版、贩卖、传播淫秽物品". Provide as single crime. Format: [罪名]制作、复制、出版、贩卖、传播淫秽物品<eoa>
